fragment: <radix.Dialog><radix.DialogTrigger><ws.element ws:tag='button' ws:style={css`background-color: #0284c7; color: #ffffff; font-weight: 600; padding: 14px 28px; border-radius: 12px; border: 0; cursor: pointer;`}>Open Dialog</ws.element></radix.DialogTrigger><radix.DialogOverlay ws:style={css`position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 9999; background-color: rgb(15 23 42 / 0.7); backdrop-filter: blur(6px); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 16px;`}><radix.DialogContent ws:style={css`width: 100%; max-width: 520px; background-color: #ffffff; border-radius: 24px; padding: 32px; box-shadow: 0 25px 50px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.25); position: relative; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;`}><$.Box ws:style={css`display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px;`}><radix.DialogTitle ws:style={css`font-size: 24px; font-weight: 800; margin: 0;`}>Modal Window</radix.DialogTitle><radix.DialogDescription ws:style={css`font-size: 15px; color: #64748b; margin: 0;`}>Radix UI Dialog modal with accessible focus management.</radix.DialogDescription></$.Box><radix.DialogClose ws:style={css`position: absolute; right: 16px; top: 16px; border-radius: 9999px; width: 32px; height: 32px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; background-color: #f8fafc; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;`}>✕</radix.DialogClose></radix.DialogContent></radix.DialogOverlay></radix.Dialog>
